statement:
∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (f : ℝ → ℂ),
  MeasureTheory.MemLp f 2 (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc a b)) →
    ∑' (i : ℤ), ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f i‖ ^ 2 = (b - a)⁻¹ • ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, ‖f x‖ ^ 2

goal.text: ∑' (i : ℤ), ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f i‖ ^ 2 = (b - a)⁻¹ • ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..b, ‖f x‖ ^ 2
